notes.title: Tutorial Level Now Available
notes.content:
Just jump through the giant sign that says "Jump In Here For Tutorial":
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33900390/0b49f0bcdfa4c1226f59f2e029e033f2d20a7e08.png[/img]

Shows the basic mechanics of the game and how to navigate around. Might clear *some* confusion -- or introduce more.

notes.title: Upcoming: Tutorial Level
notes.content: By popular demand a tutorial level is being added. Will walk players through the controls, how to navigate the world, emotion system, and tracking progress with the billboard
